definition: An authorship carrying a Dimensions researcher_id; only these IDs are linked longitudinally.
An author-paper slot without a researcher_id. It receives a paper-local key and is never merged across papers by name.
Largest h for which an author or institution has h UK Biobank papers cited at least h times in the source snapshot.
Largest g for which the g most-cited UK Biobank papers received at least g squared citations in total.
Each paper contributes one unit split equally among parsed authors, then equally among each author's distinct affiliations or countries.
Cumulative share of resolved-author fractional publication credit held by authors ranked at or above a stated top-percent threshold.
Mutually exclusive grouping of resolved authors by their number of UK Biobank publications: 1, 2-4, 5-9 or 10+.
An author's most frequent FOR, institution or country after each paper is split equally across that paper's multiple assignments; ties are deterministic.
Current organization metadata when its GRID record resolves; otherwise the author's modal observed affiliation, with the source flagged.
Female-category author-paper pairs divided by female- plus male-category pairs; unknown and androgynous names are reported but excluded from this denominator.
gender_guesser female/mostly_female and male/mostly_male calls grouped as Female and Male; all other calls Unknown.
Only exact female and male dictionary calls are classified; mostly_* and androgynous calls remain Unknown.
Exponentiated Shannon entropy of annual fractional country or institution credit.
Share of annual observed institutional fractional credit assigned to that year's leading one or ten institutions.
An undirected link between two resolved authors appearing on at least one common paper.
For a paper with n resolved authors, each coauthor edge receives 1/(n-1), so each author's collaboration credit from that paper sums to one.
Largest connected component of the cumulative resolved-author coauthorship graph.
Parallel network calculation excluding papers with more than 100 resolved authors.
Weighted Leiden modularity partition of the final fractional coauthor graph (resolution 1, seed 48652).
